_comment: Generated by tools/loot/steel_swap_map.py: what gearswap.js gives in place of each weapon and armour above the steel cap (same type or slot, steel/Imperial or leather/hide, same province), and of each high-end ingot, ore and dragon part. Do not edit "items" by hand; "metals" may be trimmed (Nate decides the list). "metals" are the ingots and ores above steel with no ore a player can mine (Adamantium, Stalhrim): never loot at any cap, cap "none" too, and swapped (Nate, 4 Oct); dragon bone and scales are not here, a slain dragon's body being their one source (dragon-materials.json); a metal players mine, and the ingot it smelts to, is never swapped and is kept out of loot by loottiers.js LOOT_ONLY_METALS (Nate, 4 Oct: "Keep mined ores, swap only gear"), as is the Dwarven metal ingot, smelted from Dwarven scrap (Nate, 4 Oct: "Keep them (crafted, like mined ores)"). "ammo" and "items" follow the cap.
